evidence.title: Beyond Verdicts: A Graph-Based Analysis of Human and LLM Reasoning in Scientific Fact-Checking

summary: A new study uses graph-based methods to evaluate how humans and large language models approach scientific fact-checking, revealing differences in reasoning processes. The findings highlight strengths and limitations of AI in verifying complex information.
title: Graph-Based Analysis Compares Human and LLM Reasoning in Scientific Fact-Checking
